text: Consider singleton MCP server with multiplexed transport (HTTP/SSE) instead of per-client stdio processes. Currently each MCP client (VS Code, Copilot CLI) spawns its own backlogit mcp process, each with an independent sql.DB connection pool against the same backlogit.db. A single long-lived server process with HTTP or SSE transport would eliminate multi-process SQLite contention entirely. NOTE: This is a contingency item -- only pursue if fixes 1-4 (busy_timeout increase, write-retry wrapper, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions, batched rehydration) prove insufficient to address concurrent session reliability. TRIAGE 2026-04-23: All four fixes shipped in 031-F (032-S). Contingency trigger condition not met. Deprioritized to low -- revisit only if multi-process contention recurs under real workloads. Effort: significant -- requires transport layer refactoring and process lifecycle management. Impact: high if needed -- eliminates the root cause of multi-process contention.

Fix/enable npm package publishing in the Release workflow (currently a tolerated best-effort failure). On the v1.3.0 release (run 28488788268), the npm-publish job in .github/workflows/release.yml failed at the "Publish platform packages" step. The job is marked continue-on-error: true by design, so it does NOT block the GitHub Release (binaries + SHA256SUMS still publish) -- but it shows a red X on every release and means npm distribution (@backlogit scope) is not actually available. Root cause per the workflow inline comment (release.yml lines 148-151): the @backlogit npm scope may not be provisioned and/or the NPM_TOKEN secret is absent, so npm publish fails (likely ENEEDAUTH / E404 / 403). Remediation: (1) provision the @backlogit org/scope on npmjs.org; (2) create an npm automation token with publish rights and add it as repo secret NPM_TOKEN; (3) verify scripts/package-npm.sh emits valid package.json for the 5 platform packages (linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, win32-x64) plus the @backlogit/backlogit-mcp wrapper; (4) validate by re-running the release job or a manual npm publish dry-run; (5) OPTIONAL hygiene: gate the npm-publish job on secret presence (e.g. if: secrets.NPM_TOKEN != null) so a red X does not appear when the token is intentionally absent. Scope: .github/workflows/release.yml (npm-publish + npm-package jobs), scripts/package-npm.sh, npm/ package templates. Until fixed, consumers install via: go install github.com/softwaresalt/backlogit/cmd/backlogit@vX.Y.Z or the release binary assets. Source: v1.3.0 release run 28488788268; release.yml lines 113-184.

Follow-up to feature covering stash A9D74372 (Stage harvest docline hardening): (a) Direction 3 DEFERRED from that chore — change how the Stage harvest commit reaches the Ship feature branch so a Stage-artifact defect (beyond docline frontmatter, e.g. committed-file scope) cannot ride into a Ship PR. Options: Stage pushes its harvest commit to origin/main before Ship branches, or harvest lands via a dedicated delivery mechanism. Larger blast radius (branch/push topology, partly Ship-owned) — evaluate before implementing. (b) Upstream template drift: the docline frontmatter contract + pre-harvest lint gate were applied to the in-repo .github/skills/impl-plan/SKILL.md and harvest/SKILL.md, but the generating .tmpl sources live in the external autoharness repo; update them there (never via out-of-tree writes from this workspace, per Principle IV) so a regeneration does not overwrite the fix. Source: plan-review of docs/exec-plans/2026-07-02-stage-harvest-docline-frontmatter-hardening-plan.md, 2026-07-02.

Fix misleading make docs-lint --path wording in 076-S ride-along artifacts. Copilot review of PR #166 correctly noted make docs-lint is a fixed repo-wide invocation (go run ./cmd/backlogit docs lint) that does NOT accept a --path arg; scoping a single file requires go run ./cmd/backlogit docs lint --path <file> directly. The wording in these ride-along artifacts still implies make docs-lint is narrowable with --path, which could mislead a future reader/agent: docs/exec-plans/2026-07-02-stage-harvest-docline-frontmatter-hardening-plan.md (~L107, ~L126) and .backlogit/archive/076.002-T.md (~L20). Reword to distinguish repo-wide make docs-lint (no args) from scoped go run ./cmd/backlogit docs lint --path <plan_path>. The shipped SKILL.md deliverables were already corrected in PR #166 — this is cleanup of historical/auto-generated ride-along docs only. The archive file is backlogit-managed state (edit via appropriate mechanism + sync, or accept a plan-only fix). Source: PR #166 Copilot threads PRRT_kwDORzozKM6OF0kp/0k1/0lG; operator-accepted 2026-07-02, fix deferred.

Phase-2 CLI/MCP parity: net-new command surfaces deferred from E16F4664 (feature 078-F phase-1, plan docs/exec-plans/2026-07-03-cli-mcp-command-parity-plan.md). Build the deferred CLI fallbacks for MCP-only tools now marked mcp_only:true in .autoharness/backlog-registry.yaml: (1) link CLI group (add/remove/list) mirroring add_link/remove_link/get_links; (2) poll_hook_events + ack_hook_events CLI; (3) save_memory CLI; (4) append_comment CLI; (5) get_wit_metadata / list_types / list_templates CLI; (6) merge_sync CLI. Evaluate each for whether a CLI fallback is genuinely valuable vs intentional-permanent MCP-only (log_telemetry is likely intentional MCP-only). Each new command must reuse the shared core path (no logic duplication), carry test-first coverage, and flip its registry row from mcp_only to a resolvable cli_command guarded by the U2 drift test. Also consider the optional phase-2 enhancement: extend ToolInfo + RenderCommandMapMarkdown so metadata export-command-map emits a per-tool cli_command/mcp_only field sourced from the operation map (so the exported command-map artifact itself carries the MCP->CLI pairing). Source: deferred scope from E16F4664 Option B deliberation, 2026-07-03.
